glosses: reading (act or process of reading, interpretation, material read, and some other senses)
playback (the replaying of something previously recorded, especially sound or moving images)
play (an instance of watching or listening to digital media)

examples.text: Quel type de lecture vous plaît ?
examples.en: What kind of reading do you like to do?

examples.text: Ce livre est une lecture fascinante.
examples.en: This book is a fascinating read.
